abstract: Carousel interfaces allow a recommender system to directly observe how far a user has browsed. This signal distinguishes displayed but unclicked items from items that were never displayed, whereas conventional ranking-bandit models, including cascade and position-based models, generally treat examination as latent. We formulate a ranking-bandit problem in which a learner presents a list of $L$ items, observes the user's maximum browsing depth, and receives click feedback only for positions up to that depth. The objective is to maximize the expected number of clicks under an unknown item-attractiveness vector and a browsing-depth distribution. We propose three algorithms based on UCB, Thompson Sampling, and DMED, all of which update item statistics only from observed exposures. We derive an instance-dependent logarithmic upper bound for our UCB-based algorithm and an asymptotic upper bound for our DMED-based algorithm that coincides with the lower bound as its parameter $α\downarrow 0$, establishing asymptotic optimality in this limit. Simulations in synthetic shallow- and deep-browsing environments, together with experiments parameterized from RecGaze interaction logs, show that OD-TS attains final mean regret similar to PBM-TS, while the proposed methods achieve lower final mean regret than PBM-UCB.
key_ideas:
🔸 将浏览深度V(t)建模为与排序无关的i.i.d.随机变量，位置j的曝光概率Pj=P(V≥j)，点击仅在深度范围内发生，期望收益为ΣPjθaj；
🔸 GetResponse子程序只对位置≤V(t)的物品累计曝光数n_i与点击数s_i，把未曝光位置显式排除，避免负例污染；
🔸 OD-UCB按样本均值加√(αlogt/n_i)的置信上界选Top-L；OD-TS用Beta后验采样排序，无需已知位置偏差；
🔸 OD-DMED-L借鉴DMED，用队列调度探索，对非Top-L物品检验n_i·d(θ̂_i,θ̂_aL)<(1+α)log(t−1)决定是否探索；
🔸 理论上证明强一致学习器的遗憾下界为Σ∆i/d(θi,θL)，OD-UCB有有限时间对数上界（α>1/2），OD-DMED-L渐近系数(1+α)倍下界。
analysis_summary:
🔸 在K=50、L=5、T=50万的三种环境（浅/深合成、RecGaze校准）中，OD-TS最终平均遗憾与PBM-TS相当（浅环境1,121.8对1,159.9，RecGaze为856.1对876.9，置信区间重叠），且无需真实Pj和拒绝采样；
🔸 三种可观测深度方法的最终遗憾均低于PBM-UCB与LastClick-UCB（如浅环境OD-UCB为6,280.6，PBM-UCB为19,568.2）；
🔸 长 horizon（T=10^7）诊断显示OD-DMED-L的Reg/log t在T=10^7时降至261.30，趋向参考值240.30，信息分配中位数1.053介于下界目标1与阈值1.1之间；
🔸 深度衰减越快，深度观测收益越大；但RecGaze实验是对数校准的模型驱动评估而非在线部署，且个别物品点击率偏高可能反映任务特定意图；
🔸 局限包括假设点击独立、深度与排序无关，OD-UCB的界非渐近最优，OD-TS与OD-DMED-L缺乏有限时间保证。
personal_view: 基于全文来看，这篇文章的创新点在于把轮播界面天然提供的浏览深度信号引入排序老虎机形式化，用确认曝光替代潜变量推断，既简化了估计（只需估计吸引力而无需位置偏差），又带来更紧的理论保证，理论—算法—实验链条完整。实用价值体现在客户端事件即可获取深度，落地门槛低；OD-TS在实用性与性能间平衡最好。局限在于独立点击与深度-排序独立的假设在真实场景可能偏理想，RecGaze实验仅为半合成校准，长期渐近最优的DMED-L短期表现平平，在线部署验证仍是未来工作。
